name: base_r1_a
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; if [ -n "${R1_ARGS:-}" ]; then python -m babylm.configs.make_base_jobs --r1 $R1_ARGS; fi; cp babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json _logs/jobs_base_r1_S.used.json

jobs.name: base_r1_a
jobs.cmd: NAMES=$(python -c "import json,os; n=[x['name'] for x in json.load(open('babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json'))['jobs'] if x['name']!='base_gpu_smoke_levers']; h=(len(n)+1)//2; print(' '.join(n[:h] if os.environ['PART']=='A' else n[h:]))"); echo "[r1] part $PART: $NAMES"; python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json --only base_gpu_smoke_levers --device cuda; SKIP=; [ -f babylm/runs/base_gpu_smoke_levers/result.json ] || { echo '[r1] smoke failed: skipping mntp cells'; SKIP='mntp'; }; for n in $NAMES; do if [ -n "$SKIP" ] && echo $n | grep -qE "$SKIP"; then echo "[r1] skip $n"; continue; fi; python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json --only $n --device cuda || echo "[r1] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[r1] score $n failed"; }; done
